# THE COMETS PRO SHOP [italic]Official Gateway Comets gear, as worn and eaten by Spin Okafor. Prices in UA dollars. Colony shipping by the next freighter with space.[/italic]
## WEAR WHAT SPIN WEARS
- [bold]Spin Sweatband[/bold], $8. The red band he wears under the helmet. In zero gravity sweat does not run, it floats in a bubble in front of your eyes. This stops that. - [bold]Comets Cap[/bold], $15. Red, peaked, with the comet tail stitched on the side. For watching, not playing. Caps are not legal in the Cage. - [bold]Number 7 Shirt[/bold], $22. Okafor on the back. Machine washable, cargo bay tested.
## TRAIN LIKE SPIN
- [bold]Protein bars[/bold], $3 each. Spin eats four before a match. The team nutritionist would like it known that she recommends two. - [bold]Space Up[/bold], $2 a can. The official drink of the Gateway Cage, and the only soda Spin will drink upside down. - [bold]Official League Ball[/bold], $40. Weighted for the Cage, which means it is heavier than you expect in gravity. Do not throw it at a window. Colony windows are expensive.
## FOR THE TROPHY CABINET
- [bold]Orbital Cup Replica Medal[/bold], $30. A replica of the 2182 Cup medal on a ribbon. Not legal tender. Not a military decoration. Please stop wearing it to garrison parades.
